description: INFRASTRUCTURE SMOKE TEST — NOT A GENERATION RESULT. Same cDCGAN as default.json with 1 epoch on a seeded 256-image subset of the training fold and a fixed small synthetic count, so the real-data path (fold manifests, forbidden-id guard, image decode, training step, checkpoint, generation, provenance, registry) runs in about a minute. Output goes to data/gan/smoke/ and results/v2/smoke/, never to the real fold directories or registry.
